---
name: my-skill
description: Build and update the SkillSathi digital skills learning website using consistent branding and functional interactive quizzes.
---

1. Brand: The website is called SkillSathi. Its tagline is "Learn Skills. Unlock Opportunities."

2. Audience: Pakistani students, fresh graduates, and young professionals learning practical digital skills.

3. Tone: Friendly, encouraging, professional, and beginner-friendly. Avoid unnecessary jargon.

4. Colours: Navy #14213D, teal #00BFA6, cream #F8FAFC, white #FFFFFF, and orange #FFB703.

5. Fonts: Use Poppins for headings and Inter for body text, with suitable fallback fonts.

6. Design: Use a modern, mobile-responsive layout with rounded cards, subtle shadows, clear spacing, and smooth hover effects.

7. Homepage: Include navigation, a hero section, learning tracks, quizzes, a progress summary, and a footer.

8. Learning tracks: Include AI Tools for Work, Spreadsheet Basics, and Digital Safety.

9. Quizzes: Provide working multiple-choice questions, answer checking, explanations, scoring, and retry buttons.

10. Progress: Save quiz results in browser localStorage and display completion and scores clearly.

11. Accessibility: Use readable text, clear buttons, keyboard-friendly controls, and sufficient colour contrast.

12. Restrictions: Never create fake testimonials, misleading claims, broken links, or nonfunctional buttons. Use HTML, CSS, and JavaScript without paid APIs.
